releaseBoundary: These lanes are URPG product-depth follow-through, not bounded v0.1.0 release blockers unless a future release scope promotes them into mandatory exit criteria.

lanes.title: Battle feedback fixture depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Governed FRL-01 battle feedback fixture depth is complete for the current scope.
currentEvidence: battle presentation profile and panel evidence counts
nextImplementation: Keep future battle feedback fixture variants covered by the same import diagnostics and coverage-row contract.
Route newly discovered plugin aliases through the existing normalized policy importer instead of adding parallel policy paths.
Open a new FRL or issue if future battle presentation work expands beyond the completed chip, zero-damage, buff-cap, and troop-position scope.
verificationCommands: ctest --preset dev-all -R "BattleRuleResolver|battle presentation|Compat fixture import: battle feedback" --output-on-failure

lanes.title: State/message/picture fixture import depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Compat migration now preserves dropped state/picture fixture rows beside diagnostics; remaining depth is broader fixture import files and rendered high-count picture fixture snapshots.
nextImplementation: Add dedicated fixture imports for scoped banks, self/map/JS variables, nested escapes, and picture task triggers.
Add high-count picture fixture snapshots outside the unit-only preview coverage.
Promote FRL-02 to ready once compat fixture files and rendered picture snapshot evidence exist.

lanes.title: Progression visual controls
lanes.remainingDepth: Stat allocation panel snapshots now expose pool/class/actor rows, stat steppers, cap warnings, disabled reasons, commit blocking, and post-load apply/already-applied controls; remaining depth is final rendered visual polish.
nextImplementation: Render the stat allocation control rows in the ImGui panel.
Add visual fixture coverage for cap blocking and already-applied post-load rows.
Promote FRL-03 to ready once rendered visual evidence exists.

lanes.title: Ability task-graph runtime sequencing
lanes.remainingDepth: Task graph runtime sequencing now reports cursor, wait state, branch transitions, effects, cue rows, cancellation, and replay rows; remaining depth is richer long-running async scheduling beyond deterministic replay.
nextImplementation: Add long-running async scheduling hooks for waits that span frames.
Keep arbitrary scripting behind an explicit unsupported/sandbox status until a safe API is defined.
Promote FRL-04 to ready once long-running async fixture evidence exists.

lanes.title: Asset promotion and preview depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Action and preview rows now expose package/readiness diagnostics for missing license, payload, thumbnail, waveform, and sequence preview evidence; remaining depth is curated bulk promotion and generated preview media.
nextImplementation: Add curated bulk-promotion manifests for the next release-safe payload groups.
Generate missing thumbnail/waveform/sequence preview records for promoted payloads.
Promote FRL-05 to ready once curated payload and generated preview fixture evidence exists.

lanes.title: Painted AI diff rendering
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed FRL-06 scope: painted diff rows, selected details, blocked-apply reasons, and a renderer-facing diff panel contract are shared by editor/chatbot snapshots.
nextImplementation: Keep future AI patch renderers consuming the shared render_contract and rows instead of reinterpreting JSON patches.
Open a new FRL if interactive side-by-side visual diff editing becomes release scope.
Preserve blocked-apply reasons in all future AI apply surfaces.

lanes.title: Automatic project filesystem walking
lanes.remainingDepth: Complete for the governed adapter-backed FRL-07 scope: bounded crawler output is indexed, diagnostics are visible, and editor/chatbot refresh controls expose a deterministic crawler invocation manifest.
nextImplementation: Keep production crawler execution behind the documented invocation manifest and ingest command contract.
Add future larger-repository stress fixtures only if crawler limits or include/exclude policies change.
Open a new FRL if live background indexing or file-watcher behavior becomes release scope.

lanes.title: Broader AI validator invocation
lanes.remainingDepth: AI validation reports now route preview artifacts through named subsystem validator rows with fallback diagnostics; remaining depth is invoking full native subsystem validators where their typed inputs are available.
nextImplementation: Invoke full typed subsystem validators for preview artifacts where the project data has enough native input.
Record external command output paths when validation delegates to scripts.
Promote FRL-08 to ready once full native validator invocation has fixture evidence.

lanes.title: Socket-level live chat streaming
lanes.remainingDepth: SSE imports now emit per-chunk diagnostics and requestStream replays chunk callbacks from captured responses; remaining depth is a true socket-backed transport that emits chunks as they arrive from the provider.
nextImplementation: Add a socket-backed streaming path that emits chunks as they arrive.
Keep curl/file-response streaming as deterministic fallback and fixture lane.
Expose live timing from the socket transport once available.

lanes.title: Native signing, notarization, and smoke launch depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Export validation now attaches platform artifact policy rows for signing, notarization, and launched-smoke evidence; remaining depth is real provider invocation and launched multi-platform smoke execution.
nextImplementation: Invoke signing/notarization providers when credentials are configured.
Run launched package smoke for generated artifacts and write smoke_evidence.json.
Promote FRL-10 to ready once provider invocation and launched smoke have fixture evidence.
